relationships.subject: ACVR1
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings suggest that ACVR1 exacerbates neuropathic pain by activating neuronal pyroptosis and neuroinflammation via the p38 and Smad1/5/8 pathways.

relationships.subject: ACVR1 inhibition
relationships.evidence_quote: Inhibition of ACVR1 alleviated mechanical allodynia, reduced neuronal pyroptosis, and decreased serum IL-1β and IL-18 levels.

relationships.subject: p38
relationships.evidence_quote: Similarly, p38 inhibition mitigated NLRP3-induced pyroptosis without altering ACVR1 expression.

relationships.subject: Smad1/5/8
relationships.evidence_quote: In contrast, Smad1/5/8 inhibition by DMH-1 effectively reduced pyroptosis and inflammation via NLRP3 but had no effect on p38 phosphorylation.

key_findings: SNI upregulates ACVR1, p-Smad1/5/8, p-p38 in spinal neurons with NLRP3, Caspase-1, GSDMD-N increases
ACVR1 acts through parallel p38 and Smad1/5/8 pathways to drive NLRP3-mediated pyroptosis
